description: List recent visitor conversations for one website, newest first, with the session id, message count and any email or phone the visitor gave.

days.description: How many days back to look (1-90, default 7).

limit.description: How many conversations to return (1-100, default 20).

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

with_leads_only.description: Only return conversations where the visitor left an email or phone.

name: list_conversations
title: List recent conversations
